name: pagination
title: Pagination
description: Pages of a long list: two secondary icon buttons around the page count in tabular figures. Show more is the quiet line under a list that opens a few more at a time, the console's usual way.
use_for: Show more under credits added, matches and history; pages only where a page is a place to come back to, such as an audit log.
never: Numbered page links in the console
Pages for a list read from the top
source: conare-web app/assets/css/console2.css (.v2-more), app/components/console/billing/Grants.vue; pages are new, on Button

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
// The quiet "Show 5 more" under a list (console2.css .v2-more): 12px medium in the soft ink that darkens under the
// pointer, a red focus ring, and a hit area 12px past its words. A list that can grow for years opens a few at a time
// with it, rather than paging.
withDefaults(defineProps<{ count?: number, label?: string }>(), { count: 5 })
</script>

<template>
  <button data-ds="show-more" type="button" class="ds-more relative ml-1 cursor-pointer text-meta font-medium whitespace-nowrap text-fg-soft"><slot>{{ label ?? `Show ${count} more` }}</slot></button>
</template>

<style>
.ds-more { transition: color var(--ds-duration-micro) var(--ds-easing-standard); }
.ds-more::after { position: absolute; inset: -12px; content: ""; }
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-more:hover { color: var(--ds-color-fg); } }
.ds-more:focus-visible { outline: var(--ds-border-focus) solid var(--ds-color-edge-accent); outline-offset: var(--ds-border-focus); }
</style>
